messages:
Alex K: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem: compiling remediation owners and timelines. Tagging folks who can take next steps. TL;DR: three high-prio items: multi-region routing policy, nightly backup verification, restore runbook dry-run. Who can own?
Sara L: I can take multi-region routing policy. Will draft policy and checklist by Mon 2025-11-03. @Mike P can you help with traffic steering tests?
Mike P: Yep I’ll own the traffic steering test harness. ETA: Wed 2025-11-05. Will add test matrix to repo: https://git.internal/redwood/failover-tests
Jen W: I'll do backup verification. Plan: automated job to verify checksum + restore test once/week. Target: POC by Fri 2025-11-07. Need access to S3 creds (or KMS), assigning to Priya to grant.
Priya S: Granting perms today. Also looping in security for KMS rotation notes. @Jen W please DM me bucket names.
Alex K: Restore runbook dry-run — can we schedule a game day? prefer next Tue 2025-11-04 16:00 PT. Ops-bot create meeting?
Taylor (ops-bot): Created calendar event: Failover Game Day — Tue Nov 4 16:00 PT. Invite: #incidents, eng-sre, eng-platform
Mike P: Heads-up: we saw similar traffic-surge-induced routing thrash in June. Action: add a canary route and abrupt-change guardrails. I'll add to test harness.
Sara L: Agree. Also suggest we codify fallback chain: primary-region -> nearest-backed-up-region -> degraded model. Will post draft policy in this thread tomorrow.
Jen W: One more: backups retention mismatch discovered in PM — we'll reconcile retention config across regions, list of buckets in the doc.
Alex K: OK owners: multi-region routing = Sara (policy) + Mike (tests); backups = Jen; perms = Priya; runbook + game day = Alex + Mike. Targets: policy Mon 11/3, tests Wed 11/5, POC backup Fri 11/7, game day Tue 11/4. I'll add these to the remediation tracker spreadsheet.
Priya S: :thumbsup: noted. Will add IAM tickets.
Jen W: FYI adding a quick snippet to run restore locally: ```bash
export BUCKET=redwood-prod-backups
aws s3 cp s3://$BUCKET/2025-10-30/db-dump.sql.gz ./
gunzip db-dump.sql.gz
psql -h localhost -U redwood -f db-dump.sql
``` Need to standardize this in runbook.
Mike P: Good. Also we should capture metrics to detect partial failover: increase in 5xx vs spike in tail latency. I'll propose SLI thresholds.
Alex K: Recurring pattern note: two incidents in 6 months tied to route config + skewed cache. Add long-term task: autosync config and reconcile KV cache warming. @Sara L can add to backlog.
Sara L: Added to backlog under 'resilience: routing + cache' — will prioritize in next sprint.
Jen W: Can we have weekly 15-min sync before game day? quick check on tickets. Tue 11/4 15:30 PT?
Alex K: Yes. Calendar invite pls.
Taylor (ops-bot): Created short sync: Failover Game Day - Pre-check — Tue Nov 4 15:30 PT. Attendees: owners.
Mike P: I'll push initial PR for test harness today, link when ready.
Alex K: Thanks all. I'll update the remediation tracker and ping owners for progress on Friday EOD.
